# SealedIn

> One API endpoint to open-weight models in GPU enclaves on Chutes, through a gateway in an Intel TDX enclave. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible. Keys are bought with USDC on Solana over x402.

## Start
- [For agents](https://sealedin.github.io/agents.md): endpoints, buying a key, models, rules
- [Models and prices](https://sealedin.github.io/models.md)
